description: pixel art scene with one single character: a small mysterious figure in a dark navy hooded cloak, its face a glowing ice-blue light, glowing ice-blue hands and feet, seen from the side facing right, raising a pickaxe over its shoulder to strike a rough dark rock wall of a mine tunnel with veins of gold ore and a few small sparkling gems in it, a small heap of broken stones at its feet, a lantern on a wooden beam, dark cave, the whole figure and the wall inside the frame

references.usage: the same small hooded figure: its dark navy cloak, its glowing ice-blue face, hands and feet, its size in the frame, the dark backdrop and the pixel style; only the work and the place are new
